entities.name: Lourdes Muñoz Santamaría
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Lourdes Muñoz Santamaría is a Spanish computer engineer, socialist politician, and open data specialist. She served as a member of the Congress of Deputies representing the province of Barcelona, where she focused on information society policy, free software advocacy, and gender equality.
